claims.text: Fitts was a managing director and board member of Dillon, Read and Co. Inc. and served as Assistant Secretary of Housing and Federal Housing Commissioner at HUD under President George H. W. Bush.
She founded Hamilton Securities Group and is founder and president of Solari, Inc., publisher of the Solari Report.
Solari, Inc. is founded by Catherine Austin Fitts and publishes the Solari Report.

edges.label: Founder and president
edges.note: Fitts is founder and president of Solari, Inc., publisher of the Solari Report and the Missing Money archive. Attested by Solari's own biography page.
